title: batch
description: One batch of items put before the owner, or the decider, in the marks view and the conversation (Implementation Decision 17; ticket 79): research/batches/<id>.json, written only by wayline.batches through the ledger. A producer opens it with its items; each item is settled by the first mark given for it, journaled as `marked`; a batch whose items are all settled is closed, and its producer reads the marks back. The mark options of each kind are the marks view's: the kind names which marks an item may take, and wayline.batches checks that every item's `marks` are its kind's and its `default` one of them.

decision.description: the decision ticket this batch answers, or null when it answers none

status.description: closed once every item is settled

ref.description: what the item is about: a plot id, an objective proposal, a merge, and so on, as its producer names it

text.description: the item as the conversation shows it whole

marks.description: the marks the item's kind allows, in the marks view's order

default.description: code's default mark, one of `marks`, or null where the kind has none for this item

note.description: the owner's note, kept with or without a mark

mark.description: the settled mark, null while the item is open

at.description: when the item was settled, as the journal spells a timestamp
